title: Summary of Journeys

questions.question: Who recorded the stages of Israel's journey?
questions.explanation: Numbers 33:2 (ESV): "Moses wrote down their starting places, stage by stage, by command of the Lord..."

questions.question: They set out from Rameses in which month?
options: The first month, on the fifteenth day
questions.correctAnswer: The first month, on the fifteenth day
questions.explanation: Numbers 33:3 (ESV): "They set out from Rameses in the first month, on the fifteenth day..."

questions.question: What were the Egyptians doing when Israel left?
questions.explanation: Numbers 33:4 (ESV): "While the Egyptians were burying all their firstborn..."

questions.question: Where did they camp after the Red Sea?
questions.explanation: Numbers 33:11 (ESV): "And they set out from the Red Sea and camped in the wilderness of Sin."

questions.question: What command did God give regarding the inhabitants of Canaan?
options: Drive out all the inhabitants and destroy their idols
questions.correctAnswer: Drive out all the inhabitants and destroy their idols
questions.explanation: Numbers 33:52 (ESV): "Then you shall drive out all the inhabitants of the land... destroy all their figured stones and... idols..."

questions.question: If they do not drive out the inhabitants, what will happen?
options: They shall be as barbs in your eyes and thorns in your sides
questions.correctAnswer: They shall be as barbs in your eyes and thorns in your sides
questions.explanation: Numbers 33:55 (ESV): "Then those of them whom you let remain shall be as barbs in your eyes and thorns in your sides..."

questions.question: How old was Aaron when he died at Mount Hor?
questions.explanation: Numbers 33:39 (ESV): "Aaron was 123 years old when he died on Mount Hor."

questions.question: Where were there twelve springs of water and seventy palm trees?
questions.explanation: Numbers 33:9 (ESV): "And came to Elim;... twelve springs of water and seventy palm trees..."

questions.question: Where was there no water for the people to drink (before Sinai)?
questions.explanation: Numbers 33:14 (ESV): "And camped at Rephidim, where there was no water for the people to drink."

questions.question: When did they come to the wilderness of Zin (Kadesh)?
questions.explanation: Numbers 33:36 (ESV): "Set out from Ezion-geber and camped in the wilderness of Zin (that is, Kadesh)."

questions.question: God said, "I will do to you as I thought to do to...?"
questions.explanation: Numbers 33:56 (ESV): "And I will do to you as I thought to do to them."

questions.question: What is another name for the salt sea mentioned here?
options: No other name listed, implied by context of borders later
questions.correctAnswer: No other name listed, implied by context of borders later
questions.explanation: Question is tricky; skip or rephrase. Let's ask: Where did they camp by the Jordan? "From Beth-jeshimoth as far as Abel-shittim"

questions.question: Where did they camp by the Jordan in the plains of Moab?
options: From Beth-jeshimoth as far as Abel-shittim
questions.correctAnswer: From Beth-jeshimoth as far as Abel-shittim
questions.explanation: Numbers 33:49 (ESV): "And they camped by the Jordan from Beth-jeshimoth as far as Abel-shittim..."

questions.question: Who heard of the coming of the people of Israel (in v40)?
options: The Canaanite, the king of Arad
questions.correctAnswer: The Canaanite, the king of Arad
questions.explanation: Numbers 33:40 (ESV): "And the Canaanite, the king of Arad... heard of the coming of the people of Israel."

questions.question: What happened at Kibroth-hattaavah (recalled by name)?
questions.explanation: Meaning of name, context from Ch 11.

questions.question: The list starts from Rameses and ends where?
options: Plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho
questions.correctAnswer: Plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho
questions.explanation: Numbers 33:48 (ESV): "And camped in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho."

key_verse_text: And you shall take possession of the land and settle in it, for I have given the land to you to possess it.
